# Bella Beauty Brazil

Bella Beauty Brazil is the beauty studio of Livia Rego at Suite 3, 412 Logan Road, Greenslopes, QLD 4120, Australia.

- Website: https://www.bellabeautybrazil.com.au/
- Booking: https://bellabrazil.gettimely.com/
- Contact: https://www.bellabeautybrazil.com.au/contact
- Phone: +61 402 148 437
- Email: livia.anjos14@gmail.com
- Services: Nano Strokes, Microblading, Shadow / Hybrid Brows, Lip Blush, Brow Sculpting & Tint, Brow Lamination, Lash Lift, Facial Treatments, Waxing, Training & Courses.
- Service areas: Greenslopes, Stones Corner, Coorparoo, Holland Park, Annerley, Tarragindi, Woolloongabba, Brisbane Southside and Greater Brisbane.

Read current service details and availability on the official Timely page. No aggregate rating, opening hours, service prices, course dates or credentials are asserted in this file.
